$comment: Single source of truth for the gallery, README tables, e2e tests, capture and library entries. Keep entries in display order.

effects.title: AI Thinking Buddy
effects.summary: A tiny robot that makes agent status readable at a glance: idle, thinking, waiting, success and error, each with its own body language.
effects.summaryZh: 一个会思考、等待、成功和失败的小机器人，用肢体语言把智能体的执行状态变得一眼可读。

effects.title: Orbit Loading Screen
effects.summary: A full loading screen for data-heavy AI and geo apps: a WebGL planet sharpens tile by tile as data arrives, next to a typographic panel with progress, steps and live details.
effects.summaryZh: 面向数据密集型 AI 与遥感应用的完整加载界面：WebGL 星球随数据到达逐块变清晰，旁边的排版面板展示进度、步骤与实时信息。

effects.title: Token Stream Text
effects.summary: Streamed LLM text that writes itself smoothly: bursty chunks are paced adaptively and each word rises out of a blur and dries from the accent color behind a glowing caret.
effects.summaryZh: 让流式 LLM 回答平滑地「落墨」：突发的分块被自适应节奏释放，每个词从模糊中浮起、由强调色褪为正文色，前方有发光的光标。
effects.preview: <ane-token-stream style="width:80%;font-size:15px;line-height:1.55;color:#e4e8f7" rate="36" caret="persist">Flood extent grew by **38%** between the two passes, mostly along the lower Rhine.</ane-token-stream>

effects.title: Satellite Scan Reveal
effects.summary: A push-broom satellite scan reveals the imagery, then a dashed inference sweep lays a land-cover mask over it. Bring your own image and mask, or use the procedural scene.
effects.summaryZh: 推扫式卫星扫描线揭示影像，随后虚线推理扫描把地物分类掩膜叠加上去；可使用自己的影像与掩膜，也可使用程序化生成的场景。
